senses.gloss:
1. अद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit or proper to be eaten;
(अम्), n. food, anything eatable.

अद्य 2. अ-द्य or Ved. अद्या, ind. (fr.
pronom. base अ, this, with द्य for द्यु, Lat. ho-die),
to-day; now-a-days; now.
—अद्य-दिन or अद्य-
दिवस, अस्, अम्, m. n. the present day.
—अद्य-
पूर्वम्, ind. before now.
—अद्य-प्रभृति, ind.
from and after to-day.
—अद्य-श्वीन, अस्, आ, अम्,
likely to happen to-day or (श्वस्) to-morrow; (आ), f.
a female near delivery.
—अद्य-सुत्या, f. preparation
and consecration of the Soma on the same day.
—अद्यापि (˚य-अपि). ind. even now, just now; to
this day; down to the present time; henceforth.
—अद्यावधि (˚य-अव्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, beginning or
ending to-day; from or till to-day.
—अद्यैव (अद्य-
एव), ind. this very day.

1. आद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being at the beginning, first,
primitive; beginning with (used in this sense like
आदि; e. g. इन्द्राद्याः सुराः, the gods beginning
with Indra, i. e. Indra &c.); immediately preceding
(e. g. एकादशाद्य, immediately before the eleventh,
i. e. the tenth; संयुक्ताद्य, immediately pre-
ceding a double consonant); being at the head, un-
paralleled, unprecedented, excellent; (अम्), n. the
beginning; आद्ये, in the beginning; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a class of deities; (आ), f. an epithet of Durgā.
—आद्य-कवि, इस्, m. the first poet, a N. of Vālmīki,
the author of the Rāmāyaṇa.
—आद्य-माषक, अस्,
m. a māṣa, a weight equal to five guñja or retti
[]
seeds, about 17(1/2) grains troy.
—आद्य-वीज, अम्, n.
a primary cause.

आद्य 2. आद्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अद्), to be
eaten edible; (अम्), n. grain, food. (For 1. आद्य see
s. v. आदि last page, col. 2.)

अद्यतन, अस्, ई, अम्, extending over or referring
to to-day; occurring or current to-day or now-a-days,
modern; (अस्), m. the period of a current day, either
from midnight to midnight, or from dawn to dark;
(ई), f. (in gram.) the aorist tense from its relating
what has occurred on the same day.
—अद्यतन-
भूत, अस्, m. the aorist.

अद्यतनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, extending over or refer-
ring to to-day; current now-a-days.
अद्यु अ-द्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. blunt.

अद्युत् अ-द्युत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. destitute of
brightness.

अद्यूत्य अ-द्यूत्य, अम्, n., Ved. unlucky
gambling; (according to others) the watch just before
the dawn; (अस्, आ, अम्,), not derived from gambling,
honestly obtained.

1. आ-द्यून, अस्, आ, अम्, shamelessly voracious (said
to come fr. आ-दिव्, but the connection of this meaning
with rt. दिव् is not very apparent). For 2. आद्य्-ऊन
see next col.

आद्यून 2. आद्य्-ऊन, अस्, आ, अम्, without be-
ginning. (For 1. आ-द्यून see last col.)

आद्योत आ-द्योत, अस्, m. (rt. द्युत्), light,
brilliance.
